q: I said to him, “Let me go now.” (Change into indirect speech)
o: I said to him that I might have been allowed to go then.
I suggest to him that I might be allowed to go then.
I told him that I might be allowed to go then.
I proposed to him that I might be allowed to go then.

q: She said that she had done her assigned work. (Make it direct)
o: She said to me, 'She did her assigned work.'
She said, "I did my assigned work."
She said, "I have done my assigned work."
She said, "She had done her assigned work"

q: He said to me, “Did you take the examination?” The indirect form is:
o: He asked me did I take the examination
He asked to me if I took the examination
He asked me if I had given the examination
He asked me if I had taken the examination
e: Yes/no প্রশ্নে indirect-এ if বা whether বসে। Past indefinite (did take) বদলে past perfect (had taken) হয়, আর you হয় I। তাই “He asked me if I had taken the examination”। প্রথম অপশনে প্রশ্নের ক্রম রয়ে গেছে, দ্বিতীয়টিতে asked to me ভুল (asked-এর পরে to হয় না), আর তৃতীয়টিতে take-এর বদলে give বসে অর্থ বদলে গেছে।

q: What is the correct indirect form of: He said to Karim, “You had better see a doctor".
o: He proposed Karim to see a doctor.
He suggested Karim that he seen a doctor.
He advised Karim to see a doctor.
He advised Karim he should see doctor.
e: "You had better see a doctor" উপদেশ দেয়। Imperative বা উপদেশমূলক বাক্যের indirect-এ ভাব অনুযায়ী reporting verb বদলায়: অনুরোধ হলে request, আদেশ হলে order, উপদেশ হলে advise। তারপর object (Karim) ও to-infinitive বসে। তাই সঠিক রূপ: He advised Karim to see a doctor. অন্য অপশনে suggested ও proposed-এর পরে সরাসরি to দেওয়া যায় না, এবং he should see doctor-এ article ও গঠনের ভুল আছে।

q: She said, "Hurray! Our team has scored the winning goal." (make it indirect)
o: She exclaimed that their team has scored the winning goal.
She shouted that their team had scored the winning goal.
She said that their team had scored the winning goal.
She exclaimed with joy that their team had scored the winning goal.
e: Hurray! জাতীয় আনন্দসূচক exclamatory বাক্যের indirect করতে reporting verb বদলে exclaimed with joy বসে (দুঃখ হলে with sorrow), তারপর that এবং reported speech-এর subject। অতীত reporting verb-এর কারণে has scored বদলে had scored হয় এবং our বদলে their হয়। তাই She exclaimed with joy that their team had scored the winning goal শুদ্ধ।

q: My friend said to me, "May you pass the pen to her." (Change the narration)
o: My friend prayed me I may pass the pen to her.
My friend wished me I might pass the pen to her.
My friend wished that I might pass the pen to her.
My friend hoped that I may pass the pen to her.
e: May you...-এর মতো শুভকামনা বা প্রার্থনা বোঝানো বাক্যের indirect narration-এ reporting verb wished হয় এবং that-এর পর might বসে। গঠন: Subject + wished + that + new subject + might + verb + object। তাই My friend wished that I might pass the pen to her শুদ্ধ। prayed বা hoped এই অর্থে খাপ খায় না।

q: Pitter said to me, “What is your aim in life?” (Make it indirect)
o: Pitter asked me what my aim in life is.
Pitter asked me what is my aim in life.
Pitter asked me what my aim in life was.
Pitter asked me what was my aim in life.

q: He said to the boy, ‘’Do not go away.’’ (Direct to Indirect)
o: He said that the had not gone away.
He ordered the boy not to go away.
He ordered the boy that he did not go away.
He told that he did not go away.

q: He said, 'Make it'. (Make it indirect)
o: He has asked it to be made.
He said that he would let it be made.
He said that let it be made.
He ordered someone to make it.

q: Choose the correct indirect speech: He said, "I am reading a book."
o: He said that he is reading a book.
He said that I was reading a book.
He said that he was reading a book.
He said that he had been reading a book.
e:
When the reporting verb 'said' is in the past tense, the tense of the reported speech goes one step back. The present continuous 'am reading' becomes the past continuous 'was reading', and the pronoun 'I' becomes 'he' to match the subject of the reporting clause.
মনে রাখুন:
Present simple → Past simple
Present continuous → Past continuous
Present perfect → Past perfect

q: Zamal said, "We must respect the rules of the game." (Make it indirect)
o: Zamal said that he had to respect the rules of the game.
Zamal said that we must respect the rules of the game.
Zamal said that they had to respect the rules of the game.
None of these

q: Anwer said, “Let him say whatever he likes.”
o: Anwer said that he may say whatever he liked
Anwer said that he might say whatever he liked
Anwer told that he might say whatever he likes
Anwer said that he might say whatever he likes
e: “Let him ...” অনুমতি বোঝায়, তাই indirect-এ may/might বসে। Reporting verb past হওয়ায় might ব্যবহার হয়, আর পরের অংশ likes বদলে liked হয়। তাই “Anwer said that he might say whatever he liked”। May অতীত reporting verb-এর সাথে খাপ খায় না, told-এর পরে object লাগে, আর শেষ অপশনে likes কাল বদলায়নি।

q: He has said to me, "I shall go out but you will stay." (make it indirect)
o: He has told me that he would go out but I should stay.
He told me that he will go out but I shall stay.
He has told me that he would go out but I shall stay.
He has told me that he will go out but I shall stay.
e: Reporting verb present বা future কালের হলে indirect করার সময় reported speech-এর tense বদলায় না, শুধু person মিলিয়ে নিতে হয়। এখানে has said present perfect, তাই shall go ও will stay-এর কোনো বদল হয় না। I শুধু he হয়, আর you বদলে I হয়। তাই He has told me that he will go out but I shall stay শুদ্ধ।

q: I said to Akash, “May you keep well”. (Make it indirect)
o: I wished Akash that he might keep well.
I prayed to Akash that he must have to keep well.
I wished Akash that he may have to keep well.
I prayed Akash that he must keep well.

q: The girl said, "Alas! My pet cat is dead."(make it indirect)
o: The girl exclaimed with grief that her pet cat was dead.
The girl exclaimed with joy that her pet cat was dead.
The girl exclaimed that her pet cat was dead.
The girl said that her pet cat was dead.

q: He said to me, "By God! I shall support you." বাক্যটির indirect speech হবে-
o: He swore by God that he will support me. [রেজিস্টার্ড বেসরকারি
He swore by God that he will have supported me. প্রাথমিক শিক্ষক (শাপলা)-১১
He swear by God that he would have supported me.
He swore by God that he would support me.

q: He said to me, 'You do not do your duty.' (Make it indirect)
o: He told me that I did not do my duty.
He said to me that I did not do my duty.
He told to me that I did not do my duty.

q: The old man said to me, "May Allah help you in your life." (make it indirect)
o: The old man wished that Allah might help me in my life.
The old man prayed that Allah help me in my life.
The old man hoped that Allah may help me in my life.
The old man said that might Allah help me my life.
e: "May Allah help you" দোয়া বা শুভকামনা প্রকাশ করে, অর্থাৎ optative sentence। এর indirect-এ said বদলে wished বা prayed বসে, quotation চিহ্নের জায়গায় that আসে, আর reporting verb past হওয়ায় may বদলে might হয়। Speaker যাকে বলছেন সেই "me"-র কথা বলা হচ্ছে, তাই you বদলে me হয়। সঠিক রূপ: The old man wished that Allah might help me in my life. Hoped-এর সঙ্গে may রেখে দিলে tense মেলে না, আর prayed-এর পরে might ছাড়া শুধু help লেখা ব্যাকরণসম্মত নয়।

q: Farida said to her mother, “I shall go to bed now.” Make it indirect speech.
o: Farida said to her mother that she should go to bed now
Farida told her mother that she will go to bed then
Farida said to her mother that she would go to bed then
Farida said to her mother that she should goes to bed now
e: Direct speech-এ shall বা will থাকলে, reporting verb past হলে, indirect-এ সেগুলো would হয়ে যায়। Now বদলে then বসে, আর I বদলে বক্তা Farida অনুযায়ী she হয়। তাই “she would go to bed then” (সে তখন ঘুমাতে যাবে বলল)। Should মানে বাধ্যবাধকতা, তাই অর্থ বদলে যায়। ‘should goes’ ব্যাকরণগত ভুল, আর will রাখলে কাল মিলে না।

Alex said, "I finished my homework long before."
